remarks: Discover the Metro Shift 20 by Cantiro Homes, a thoughtfully designed rear-laned home that combines modern style with functional living spaces. Featuring the Linen interior style, the main floor offers a spacious, chef-inspired kitchen complete with a large island and Whirlpool stainless steel appliances, seamlessly flowing into the bright and inviting dining and living areas. Upstairs, the primary bedroom provides a relaxing retreat with a walk-in closet and private ensuite, accompanied by two additional bedrooms. Additional features include a detached garage, SEPERATE SIDE ENTRANCE, 9' basement ceilings, rough-in floor drains, a gas range, and 7' x 7' rear deck.   Photos are for representation only and may differ from the finished home. Features and finishes may vary. (id:67522)
